dedup_rule.statement: Deduplicate at the MECHANISM level, not the wording level. A mechanism is the triple (verb_set, locus, artifact_set): WHAT the record does, WHERE the change lands, and WHICH concrete named things it operates on. Two records describing the same triple in different words are duplicates; two records sharing wording but differing in the triple are not.
dedup_rule.D1_identity: Same local id across a document and a document that DECLARES itself that document's consolidation (07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.md over the five 07-OPTIONS-*.md lane docs) => same record. Exact, no judgement.
dedup_rule.D2_authored_absorption: 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.md section 3 publishes a dedup ledger of (canonical <- absorbed) edges. Those 55 edges are INHERITED and tagged authored-ledger. They are NOT evidence that D3 works -- they are the positive control D3 is measured against.
dedup_rule.D3_mechanism_signature: verb agreement (jaccard(verbs) >= 0.50 OR |verbs cap| >= 3) AND locus COMPATIBILITY (top-2 locus sets intersect) AND artifact agreement (both name concrete artifacts -> jaccard(hard) >= 0.25 OR |hard cap| >= 2; otherwise jaccard(soft_concepts) >= 0.60). A record that names no concrete artifact cannot DISAGREE about one, so the asymmetric case falls through to the concept path instead of being rejected.
dedup_rule.D4_authored_distinction_veto: If either record's own 'not a duplicate:' field names the other's id, they are NEVER merged whatever D3 says. A lexical signature does not overrule an authored distinction. This is the precision guard.
dedup_rule.D5_verify_document_target_identity: Two adversarial verification documents re-verifying ONE finding collapse when TWO signals derived from DIFFERENT parts of the document agree: (a) BODY -- the concrete artifact paths named in the document head intersect, AND (b) NAME -- topic-slug token jaccard >= 0.60 after stripping the ADV/VERIFY/Vn scaffolding, which encodes only which PASS ran, never what was verified. Requiring both is what stops D5 degrading into a filename-similarity rule. 24 merges fired on this corpus and all 24 were hand-audited as genuine re-verifications; that audit is author judgement, not a mechanical control, and the settling experiment is an independent reviewer re-adjudicating the same 24.
dedup_rule.error_direction: Tuned for PRECISION, not recall. A false MERGE destroys a distinct mechanism invisibly; an under-merge leaves the duplicate pair sitting in the output where it is auditable. Operating point chosen by a criterion fixed before the sweep: maximise recall subject to false_merge_rate <= 0.02.

ranking_rule.statement: Rank by independent evidence, cross-domain convergence, severity and decision impact. repetition_count is COMPUTED and PUBLISHED but carries WEIGHT ZERO.
anti_repetition_corrections: All records from ONE source document collapse to ONE lineage.
A declared consolidation of another document does NOT count as a second lineage -- that is the same authors re-reading their own output.
Evidence is counted once per KIND (executed output / file:line / both-states control / second independent probe), never once per record asserting it.
ranking_rule.proof: test_corpusnorm.py::test_repetition_has_zero_weight clones a cluster's supporting records 10x and asserts the composite score is bit-identical.
